### Q2. JEE Advanced 2018 (Paper 1)

*Type:* `numerical` | *Level:* `2`

<p>Three identical capacitors <math><msub><mrow><mi>C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mrow><mi>C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mi> </mi><msub><mrow><mi>C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> have a capacitance of <math><mn>1.0</mn><mi> </mi><mi>μ</mi><mi>F</mi></math> each and they are uncharged initially. They are connected in a circuit as shown in the figure and <math><msub><mrow><mi>C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> is then filled completely with a dielectric material of relative permittivity <math><msub><mrow><mi>ϵ</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>r</mi></mrow></msub></math> . The cell electromotive force (emf) <math><mrow> <msub> <mi>V</mi> <mn>0</mn> </msub> </mrow> <mi> </mi><mo>=</mo><mi> </mi><mn>8</mn><mi> </mi><mi>V</mi></math> . First the switch <math><msub><mrow><mi>S</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> is closed while the switch <math><msub><mrow><mi>S</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> is kept open. When the capacitor <math><msub><mrow><mi>C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> is fully charged, <math><msub><mrow><mi>S</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> is opened and <math><msub><mrow><mi>S</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> is closed simultaneously. When all the capacitors reach equilibrium, the charge on <math><msub><mrow><mi>C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> is found to be <math><mn>5</mn><mi> </mi><mi>μ</mi><mi>C</mi></math> . The value of <math><msub><mrow><mi>ϵ</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>r</mi></mrow></msub></math> =____________.
<img src="https://cdn-question-pool.getmarks.app/pyq/jee_advanced/xyzryitbyxwnrebtgcoxxtfvgsobjhwmsianjxhzumtgpbkpbd.jpeg"/></p>

<details>
<summary><b>View Answer & Solution</b></summary>

**Correct Value:** **1.5**

**Detailed Solution:**

<img src="https://cdn-question-pool.getmarks.app/pyq/jee_advanced/11_solu_phy.jpg"/>

<img src="https://cdn-question-pool.getmarks.app/pyq/jee_advanced/11_solu_1_phy.jpg"/>

Applying loop rule

<math><mfrac><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><msub><mrow><mo>∈</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>r</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>

<math><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><msub><mrow><mo>∈</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>r</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></math>

<math><msub><mrow><mo>∈</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>r</mi></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1.50</mn></math>

</details>

### Q3. JEE Advanced 2013 (Paper 1)

*Type:* `multipleCorrect` | *Level:* `2`

<p>In the circuit shown in the figure, there are two parallel plate capacitors each of capacitance <em>C</em>. The switch <em>S<sub>1</sub></em> is pressed first to fully charge the capacitor <em>C<sub>1</sub></em> and the released. The switch <em>S<sub>2</sub></em> is then pressed to charge the capacitor <em>C</em><sub>2</sub>. After some time, <em>S<sub>2</sub></em> is released and then is<em> S<sub>3</sub></em> pressed. After some time,
<img src="https://cdn-question-pool.getmarks.app/pyq/jee_advanced/EM00012549_JEE_ADVANCED_2013.jpg"/></p>

**Options:**

- **(A)** the charge on the upper plate of C<sub>1</sub> is 2CV<sub>0 </sub>.
- **(B)** the charge on the upper plate of C<sub>1</sub> is CV<sub>0 </sub>.
- **(C)** the charge on the upper plate of C<sub>2</sub> is 0.
- **(D)** the charge on the upper plate of C<sub>2</sub> is - CV<sub>0 </sub>.

<details>
<summary><b>View Answer & Solution</b></summary>

**Correct Option:** **(D) the charge on the upper plate of C<sub>2</sub> is - CV<sub>0 </sub>.**

**Detailed Solution:**

When S<sub>1</sub> is closed,
charge on <math> <mrow> <msub> <mtext>C</mtext> <mn>1</mn> </msub> <mo>=</mo> <mn>2</mn> <msub> <mtext>V</mtext> <mn>0</mn> </msub> <mtext>C</mtext> </mrow> </math>
After S<sub>2</sub> is closed, half of the change will move to C<sub>2</sub>
<math> <mrow> <mo>&#8756;&#160;&#160;</mo> </mrow> </math> charge on <math> <mrow> <msub> <mtext>C</mtext> <mn>1</mn> </msub> <mo>=</mo> <mfrac> <mrow> <mn>1</mn> </mrow> <mrow> <mn>2</mn> </mrow> </mfrac> <mn>2</mn> <msub> <mtext>V</mtext> <mn>0</mn> </msub> <mtext>C</mtext> </mrow> </math>
when S<sub>2</sub> is closed,
charge on <math> <mrow> <msub> <mtext>C</mtext> <mn>2</mn> </msub> <mo>=</mo> <msub> <mtext>V</mtext> <mn>0</mn> </msub> <mtext>C</mtext> </mrow> </math> but with reversed polarity,
<math> <mrow> <mo>&#8756;&#160;&#160;</mo> </mrow> </math> Charge on upper plate <math> <mrow> <mo>=</mo> <mo>-</mo> <msub> <mtext>V</mtext> <mn>0</mn> </msub> <mtext>C</mtext> </mrow> </math>

</details>

### Q4. JEE Advanced 2012 (Paper 2)

*Type:* `singleCorrect` | *Level:* `2`

In the given circuit, a charge of $+80 \mu C$ is given to the upper plate of the $4 \mu F$ capacitor. Then in the steady state, the charge on the upper plate of the $3 \mu F$ capacitor is

<img src=" data:image/png;base64,">

**Options:**

- **(A)** $+32 \mu \mathrm{C}$
- **(B)** $+40 \mu \mathrm{C}$
- **(C)** $+48 \mu \mathrm{C}$
- **(D)** $+80 \mu \mathrm{C}$

<details>
<summary><b>View Answer & Solution</b></summary>

**Correct Option:** **(C) $+48 \mu \mathrm{C}$**

**Detailed Solution:**

The total charge on plate $A$ will be $80 \mu \mathrm{C}$.

$2 \mu F$ and $3 \mu F$ capacitors are in parallel. Therefore, $C_{e q}=2+3=5 \mathrm{HF}$

Charge on capacitor of $3 \mu \mathrm{F}$ capacitance $q=\frac{3}{5} \times 80=48 \mu C$

<img src="https://cdn-question-pool.getmarks.app/pyq/jee_advanced/hg2rttPavpB446uZyDbOiN4HL3hyjh-OD7VgG6EegZM.original.fullsize.png">

</details>
